references.note: Accepted skin vegetation wall master: same mushroom cap material, colours and lighting, now seen from straight above
Accepted board wall-top convention: opaque full-bleed overhead material, edge to edge, no perspective side

grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed wall-top material; the exporter crops fixed windows per neighbour mask, adds cap rims on exposed sides and a stem face (from the existing vegetation master) on south edges toward open ground, 2 parities.

prompt_fields.subject: The top of a dense fungal thicket wall seen from straight above: a tightly packed canopy of overlapping broad mushroom caps of mixed large, medium and small sizes covering the whole square, each cap a rounded lumpy disc with a crisp pale lit rim toward the upper left, speckled moss patches, and narrow near-black shadow crevices between caps; no ground shows through.
prompt_fields.palette: Dark plum-brown caps, moss olive patches, dull cream highlights only on cap rims; low-key and dark overall, sickly earth tones, upper-left light.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a dark solid blocking mass filling its cell, clearly darker and heavier than the flat cave floor; broad crisp cap shapes with sharp lit rims and deep dark crevices between caps, not fine noise, not blurry or painterly-soft.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead material filling the whole square with even density; caps are cut off by all four edges and continue beyond them; no border, gap, visible floor, cliff face, perspective side, stems, single centred object or cast shadow outside the caps.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Blocking vegetation wall top only. Paint no door, opening, path, stairs, hazard, creature, symbol or text.
